content.text: No non-solicitation or no-hire provision exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or "induce to leave" covenant binding Customer. The two plausible homes for such a covenant — § 14.8 (Personnel), which only allocates supervision/assignment of each party's own personnel and IBM's subcontracting right, and § 14.16 (Freedom of Action), which expressly confirms each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others — impose no hiring restriction. Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ" and "induce" return no restrictive-covenant language anywhere in the document. This matches our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
